Upstream: cynic-introspection3.14.0, MPL-2.0, https://codeberg.org/obmarg/cynic

Source-only dependency patch for GraphQL-JS16.14.2 interoperability: include the standard DIRECTIVE_DEFINITION value in the introspection schema, mature DirectiveLocation enum/deserializer, and SDL location formatter. Its explicit workspace boundary excludes upstream dev dependencies from application builds. MPL2.0 license text is included from the SPDX license-list text distribution; this file identifies the modifications to upstream covered source files.
